zh: 《生活大爆炸》前情提要
en: Previously on The Big Bang Theory...

zh: 你能相信我们的小羊羔终于要嫁人了吗
en: Can you believe our little lamb is finally getting married?

zh: 他肯定不信
en: He can't believe it.

zh: 我也不敢相信
en: And neither can I.

zh: 爸 你还好吗
en: Hi, Dad. How you doing?

zh: 我以"连你都能证婚网"
en: Then by the power vested in me...

zh: 所赋予我的合法权利
en: by EvenYouCanPerformWeddings.Com...

zh: 我现在宣布你们正式结为合法夫妻
en: ...I now pronounce you husband and wife.

zh: 你可以吻新娘了
en: You may kiss the bride.

zh: 时至今日
en: and now...

zh: 早安啊 老婆
en: Good morning, wife.

zh: 早安啊 老公
en: Good morning, husband.

zh: 真不敢相信我们真的结婚了
en: I can't believe we're actually married.

zh: 正式完婚了 根据传统
en: It's official. According to tradition,

zh: 我们应该把床单挂在外面
en: we should hang the bedsheets outside

zh: 这样其他村民就能知道我们行过房了
en: so the villagers can see that we consummated.

zh: 毕竟我们是在这种地方开始我们的蜜月之旅
en: considering where we're starting our honeymoon.

zh: 你说的有道理
en: Well, I suppose you're right.

zh: 乐高有着形容夫妻房事的最完美隐喻呢
en: Lego is the perfect metaphor for marital congress.

zh: 两片乐高"合体"并带有爽度十足的咔哒声
en: Two pieces that interlock with a satisfying snap.

zh: 我差点就忘了
en: Oh, I almost forgot.

zh: 在你睡觉的时候 我点了客房送餐
en: While you were sleeping, I ordered room service.

zh: 真的吗
en: Really?

zh: 请看
en: Voila!

zh: 你本来还以为是食物 对吧
en: You thought it was going to be food, didn't you?

zh: 我们的宇宙曾经超热又超密
en: Our whole universe was in a hot, dense state

zh: 直到大约140亿年前的某一天宇宙膨胀开始了 等等
en: Then nearly 14 billion years ago expansion started... Wait!

zh: 地球开始冷却
en: The Earth began to cool

zh: 自养生物开始发育 尼安德塔人发明工具
en: The autotrophs began to drool, Neanderthals developed tools?

zh: 我们建了长城 我们建了金字塔
en: We built the Wall We built the pyramids

zh: 数学 科学 历史 解开了谜团
en: Math, Science, History, unraveling the mystery

zh: ♪ 数学 科学 历史 解开了谜团 ♪
en: ♪ Math, Science, History, unraveling the mystery ♪

zh: 一切都始于大爆炸
en: That all started with a big bang

zh: 炸
en: Bang!

zh: 谢尔顿跟艾米出去度蜜月你们是不是很爽啊
en: Is it nice having Sheldon and Amy away on their honeymoon?

zh: 是啊 因为我跟莱纳德有大把的独处时间
en: Yeah, because now Leonard and I get all this alone time.

zh: 但你俩不能独处啊 我们在呢
en: But you're not alone. We're here.
